JSCR is the official research journal of the NSCA, published by Wolters Kluwer/LWW; journals.lww.com/nsca-jscr is a presentation page and the canonical IFA lives at https://edmgr.ovid.com/jscr/accounts/ifauth.htm

encoding_notes: TIER_A live-clean: canonical IFA at edmgr.ovid.com/jscr/accounts/ifauth.htm rendered headless via Apify rag-web-browser, HTTP 200; WebFetch on the same URL 402'd. Publisher is Wolters Kluwer/LWW (official research journal of the NSCA); no publisher migration.

Article-type mapping: 'original investigations'->original_research; 'systematic reviews' and 'meta-analyses'->systematic_review; 'narrative (and meta-narrative) reviews'->narrative_review; 'technical and methodological reports'->technical_note; 'Manuscript Clarifications' (400-word post-publication correspondence posing questions to authors)->letter.

Research notes ('a brief research study ~1500-2000 words ... formatted identical to an original study': Abstract, Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, Practical Applications, References, with limited tables/figures/references) share the original_research structure and are NOT encoded as a separate type (no enum slot).
Omitted with no clean enum slot: Symposia (a group of articles by different authors addressing an issue from various perspectives).

Word limits: guide explicitly states 'There are no word limitations to original studies and reviews' and 'There is no word limit to the reviews'; manuscript_max_words=null for original_research/systematic_review/narrative_review. Only stated numeric length cap is the 400-word Manuscript Clarification (encoded as letter).
SCHEMA GAP — Practical Applications sub-section is capped at 350 words ('This section should be limited to 350 words or less'); no field for a per-section cap, noted here.

references.style='custom': NSCA house style — references are ALPHABETIZED by first-author surname AND numbered (order='alphabetical'), cited in text as parenthetical numbers e.g. (4,9). Format 'Author AB, Author CD. Title. Journal vol: pages, year.' with NLM-abbreviated, italicized journal titles (e.g. 'J Strength Cond Res'). Does not match standard Vancouver (cited-order) or AMA; encoded custom.

references.et_al_threshold SCHEMA GAP: guide rule is 'For journal entries with 6 or more co-authors, please list the first 3 names followed by et al.' i.e. list ALL authors when 5 or fewer, truncate to first 3 + et al. when 6+. The single-int field cannot hold both the 6-author trigger and the keep-3 count; encoded 3 (the kept count / JSCR-distinctive 'first 3 et al.').

references_max=60 for original_research reflects 'please limit the number of references to fewer than 60 or explain why more are necessary' (i.e. <60); reviews have no stated reference cap (null). references.max_count left null as the cap is type-specific.

layout: 'minimum of 1-inch margins' -> 25.4 mm all sides (stated as a minimum). Manuscripts 'double-spaced with an additional space between paragraphs' -> double. 'page numbers in the upper right corner next to the running head' -> running_head + page_numbers both top-right.

layout gaps: font family and size NOT specified in the guide -> null/null. page_size not specified -> null (US journal but not stated). alignment not specified -> null. first_line_indent not specified -> null. Guide does NOT mention manuscript line numbers -> line_numbers='none' (no null option in enum; guide silent).

headings: level-1 text sections are ALL CAPS and in exact order — 'titles in ALL CAPS (i.e. INTRODUCTION, METHODS, RESULTS, DISCUSSION, PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS, ACKNOWLEDGMENTS, and REFERENCES) in this exact order'. Level-2 METHODS subheadings are prescribed in order: 'Experimental Approach to the Problem', 'Subjects', 'Procedures', 'Statistical Analyses' (encoded case='title' from the quoted phrasing). bold/italic for headings NOT specified -> encoded false (unstated).

abstract: unstructured — 'an abstract with a limit of 250 words ... The abstract should have sentences (no headings)' covering purpose, brief methods, results, conclusions, practical applications, plus a stated significance level (e.g. p<=0.05). structured=false, sections=null, max_words=250.
keywords: '3 - 6 key words not used in the title' -> required min 3, max 6; case/separator unspecified -> null.

blinding: double-blind peer review (occasionally single-blind if a Senior Associate Editor must review). A full Title Page (identifying) plus a separate 'Blind Title Page' with only the manuscript title; 'Do not place identifying information in the Acknowledgment portion of the paper or anywhere else in the manuscript' -> separate_title_page + scrub_body_identifiers true. Document/file metadata scrubbing not explicitly mentioned -> scrub_metadata=false (unstated).

title_page.elements from the 'Title Page' item: manuscript title, brief running head, laboratory(s), authors' full names with middle initials, department(s)/institution(s), corresponding author full mailing address incl. phone/fax/email, and disclosure of funding (NIH/Wellcome/HHMI/other). No abstract/keywords/word-counts/article-type/ORCID on the title page. authors_degrees not addressed ('full names spelled out with middle initials') -> null.

tables: 'Tables must be double-spaced on separate sheets and include a brief title'; 'Table files must be MADE in Word NOT copied into Word'; cited in text with 'Table 1 about here' callouts -> placement=grouped_end, numbering=arabic. Caption/title position (above vs below) not explicitly stated -> null.

figures: submitted as separate files, one figure per separate page ('One set of figures should accompany each manuscript'). Accepted print formats TIFF or EPS (also native .psd/.ai/.ppt/.qxd which have no enum slot). DPI tiered: images min 300 ppi, line art 1200 ppi -> min_dpi=300 (photograph floor). Figure legends on a separate page -> figure_legends_section. Callouts 'Figure 1 about here' -> callout_style='Figure'.

declarations: Acknowledgments section (section 6, before References) bundles: (1) disclose professional relationships/conflict of interest, (2) cite specific grant support/funding, plus an NSCA non-endorsement statement, and optionally individual author contributions ('may be listed here'). Ethics/IRB approval + informed consent required in the Methods/'Subjects' subsection ('the manuscript will not be considered for publication' otherwise) -> required includes ethics_approval. Trial registration 'recommended' and data sharing 'recommended' (not mandatory) -> not encoded as required. Patient consent / photo release conditional on identifiable subjects -> not always-required.

misc: cover letter required (must include the originality statement + corresponding-author contact). ORCID not mentioned -> orcid_required=false. No Highlights -> highlights_required=false. Article title case not specified -> title_case=null.
